decision_table.name: Determine_MS_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Mississippi state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in MS (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
MS filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
A corporation has physical presence nexus in MS if it has: - An office, store, warehouse, or other place of business in MS - Employees working in MS - Tangible personal property located in MS - Real property located in MS
Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-19 (Nexus and filing requirements) Reference: Mississippi Department of Revenue Business Tax Guide

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
MS filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Economic nexus threshold: $250,000 gross receipts in MS.
Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), MS requires filing if a corporation exceeds economic nexus thresholds, even without physical presence.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Mississippi Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-19 (Filing requirements)

No MS nexus - no filing requirement.
Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. Any estimated payments would be refunded.
Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-19 (Nexus requirements)

decision_table.name: Calculate_MS_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate MS state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
MS state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
MS ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: - Interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to MS) - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback (if MS does not conform) - State income taxes deducted on federal return - Bonus depreciation addback (varies by tax year) - Expenses related to exempt income
MS SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: - Interest on MS state and municipal bonds - MS net operating loss deduction (5-year carryforward, no carryback) - Dividend income eligible for MS dividend received deduction - Certain refunds of state income taxes
Reference: MS Form 83-100 Schedule A (Additions to Federal Taxable Income) Reference: MS Form 83-100 Schedule B (Deductions from Federal Taxable Income) Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-5 (Adjustments to federal taxable income)

No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.
Corporation does not have MS nexus, so no income adjustments are needed.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MS_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate MS state corporate income tax. Applies MS graduated rates (3%, 4%, 5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
MS state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to MS: × [MS apportionment percentage] 3. MS additions: + [Federal interest, IRC 199A addback, etc.] 4. MS subtractions: - [MS municipal interest, MS NOL, etc.] 5. MS taxable income: = [Result] 6. MS tax calculation (graduated rates): - 3% on first $5,000 - 4% on next $5,000 ($5,001-$10,000) - 5% on income over $10,000 7. MS income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. MS credits: - [Jobs, investment, R&D, film, etc.] 9. MS tax liability: = [Final tax]
MS uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor) for most businesses.
MS tax rate structure (Mississippi Code § 27-7-5): - $0 - $5,000: 3% - $5,001 - $10,000: 4% - Over $10,000: 5%
MS provides various tax credits including: - Jobs creation tax credit - Investment tax credit - Research & development credit - Film production credit - Alternative fuel credit
MS allows net operating loss carryforward for 5 years (no carryback).
Reference: MS Form 83-100 (Corporate Income and Franchise Tax Return) Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-5 (Tax rates) Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-19 (Apportionment) Reference: Mississippi Department of Revenue Business Tax Guide

No MS nexus - no tax liability.
Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in MS. Any estimated payments are refunded.
Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-19 (Nexus requirements)

No MS taxable income - no tax liability.
Corporation has MS nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. Any estimated payments are refunded.
MS net operating loss (NOL) rules: - MS allows NOL carryforward for 5 years - No carryback allowed - NOL deduction limited by MS-specific rules
Reference: MS Form 83-100 (Corporate Income and Franchise Tax Return) Reference: Mississippi Code § 27-7-5 (Net operating loss provisions)
